en-GB.h1: Golf Green Card rules test – practise the questions
en-GB.lead: Get ready for the golf rules and etiquette test beginners take: the Grönt kort test in Sweden, the Green Card in Finland or the Turnier-Lizenz test in Austria. Each answer comes with an explanation.

benefits.d: In 10 topics, from etiquette to scoring and handicap.
Drawn course situations such as penalty areas and boundary stakes.
Sweden, Finland, Austria and a Norway quiz format.
Until you have answered them right twice in a row.
Plain-language answers with the rule number, plus a first-round checklist.

faq.q: Which golf rules tests does the app cover?
faq.a: The Grönt kort knowledge test in Sweden, the Green Card test in Finland and the Turnier-Lizenz rules test in Austria. In Norway, where "Veien til golf" has replaced the test, it helps you learn the rules.

faq.q: What do the mock exams look like?
faq.a: Sweden 2 x 25 questions (at least 20 per part), Finland 15 rules plus 15 etiquette, Austria 31 questions (pass at 20 correct) and a 20-question quiz for Norway.

faq.q: Which languages are the explanations in?
faq.a: English, Norwegian, Swedish, Finnish or German. Choose your country and the questions follow the language of its test.
Yes, it works offline, with no account and no ads.
No. You unlock everything with a single purchase. Ten sample questions, one short mock exam, the rules lookup and the checklist are included without a purchase.

faq.q: Are these the official test questions?
faq.a: No. All questions and rule summaries are written by us, and the app is not affiliated with any golf federation. Ask your club how the test is taken.
